No map, route, line length, or in-service date is published.

interconnections.name: Okatie – McIntosh 115 kV tie line (series reactor + new Deerfield Switching Station)
interconnections.description: DESC's SCRTP lists (2025-2029 p.42; 2026-2030 p.41) call the Okatie – McIntosh 115 kV line a 'Tie Line'. Project 6888 (Planned, ISD 12/31/2028) builds a Deerfield Switching Station and adds a 9% series reactor on it. The project is not in the 2024-2028 list. The DESC source does not name the counterparty or say where the reactor or Deerfield will be. 'McIntosh' plausibly means Georgia Power's McIntosh substation (Effingham County, GA). In OSM, a 115 kV line (way/185380584) runs from McIntosh Substation to an unnamed 115 kV substation in Jasper County, SC, and a 115 kV line tagged operator 'Dominion Energy' (way/1062495950) runs from that site toward Okatie. Those tags are mapper-supplied, and no second official source confirms the link. The GPC 2024 ten-year plan has no Okatie or Deerfield item. Treat this as interconnection design context only; it is not resource sharing.

interconnections.name: Southern Balancing Authority – DESC interface (system level)
interconnections.description: System-level context, not tied to any project. GPC's ten-year plan says GPC, Southern Company and OPC have interchange and reliability agreements with DESC. It lists DESC among the SBAA 'northern' interfaces whose transfer capability is assessed together, and its glossary names DESC among the VACAR interconnections. The 2025 SERTP plan's Table A6.2 models Southern BAA interface commitments by neighbor. The DESC value is 0 MW in 2027, 2030 and 2035; the Duke Carolinas column beside it is also 0, and the rows sum to the printed totals. SCRTP's June 3, 2025 stakeholder slides list earlier economic planning studies of hypothetical SOCO-to-DESC transfers (2023: 1300 MW and 950 MW, 2028/29 winter; 2024: 300 MW, 2025 summer). These are studies, not commitments or projects. Planning-process context: DESC is currently in the SCRTP region. The SCRTP and SERTP sites say DESC and Santee Cooper plan to join SERTP with DESC's Order 1920 compliance filing, and that the SERTP sponsors and SCRTP companies are working toward the needed OATT changes. The SC PSC scheduled a March 5, 2026 briefing on the SERTP Order 1920 process, requested by ORS, DESC, Santee Cooper and Duke. This is process-level coordination only; none of it concerns a specific project or resource sharing.

evidence.exactExcerpt: GPC, Southern Company (SoCo), and Oglethorpe Power Corporation (OPC) have interchange and reliability agreements with other systems such as Duke Power, Dominion Energy South Carolina (DESC), Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA), and the Florida utilities.

unresolved: No SC PSC, GA PSC, SERTP or SCRTP statement was found saying DESC and Georgia Power coordinate on any of these projects: Okatie – McIntosh tie 6888, McIntosh – Purrysburg reactors 20277, the Thurmond rebuilds, Effingham County 500 kV, or Callaway Road – Thomson 500 kV. knownCoordination is left empty. This is 'not found in sources', not evidence of no coordination.

Documents checked for coordination statements: gpc-effingham-page, gpc-callaway-thomson-page, sertp-2025-plan (searched Dominion/DESC/SCE&G/McIntosh/Purrysburg/Thurmond/Goshen/Evans/Thomson/Vogtle/Callaway/Effingham/Okatie), gpc-irp-2025-vol3, the three DESC SCRTP lists, scrtp-home, sertp-home, scrtp-meeting-2025-06-03, and scpsc-aep-briefing-2026-03. The SC PSC briefing (docket ND-2024-46-E; scheduled for March 5, 2026, and not confirmed as held) covers the SERTP FERC Order 1920 stakeholder process in general, not these projects.

Plan context: the SCRTP and SERTP home pages both say DESC and Santee Cooper plan to join SERTP, effective with DESC's Order 1920 compliance filing (the SERTP news item sits under the September 30th, 2025 entry). The 2025 SERTP plan (Nov 26, 2025) still lists only Duke for South Carolina in Table I.1 (p.7). There, DESC appears only as an interface (Table A6.2, p.217), as 'SCE&G' in the Duke Energy Carolinas interface table (p.185), or as the 'DESC Eastover' terminal of Duke Progress projects (pp.51, 53). DESC's projects are not yet in a SERTP regional plan.

The owner and location of Purrysburg (McIntosh – Purrysburg 230 kV tie lines, GPC 20277) are not stated in any source found. OSM names no Purrysburg substation. Nominatim finds only Purrysburg Road segments in Jasper County, SC; one (way 12420907, 32.3691,-81.1215) runs about 0.1 km from an unnamed OSM 230/115 kV substation (way/185380609, 32.3688,-81.1224). That substation sits beside 'Jasper Substation' (way/185380597, 230 kV, no operator tag) and DESC's Jasper Generating Plant (OSM operator Dominion Energy South Carolina). An OSM 230 kV line (way/185380583) runs from this site to McIntosh. These are candidates only. Do not plot Purrysburg or attribute it to DESC.

Whether DESC's 'McIntosh' (Okatie – McIntosh 115kV Tie, 6888) is Georgia Power's McIntosh substation (OSM way/121624352, Effingham County, GA) needs a second official source. OSM context only (mapper-supplied tags): 115 kV line way/185380584 runs from McIntosh Substation (32.3514,-81.1741) to an unnamed 115 kV substation in Jasper County, SC (way/1097170331, 32.3671,-81.1212). 115 kV line way/1062495950, tagged operator 'Dominion Energy', runs from the adjacent SC substation (way/185380609) ESE to about 32.287,-80.933, 1.4 km from Okatie Village (Nominatim). The GPC plan documents SC tie lines 'at McIntosh' only at 230 kV (Purrysburg). No official document ties the 115 kV Okatie line to GPC McIntosh, so no shared-site relation was recorded for desc-6888 with gpc-20065, gpc-20277 or gpc-20989.

The locations of the Deerfield Switching Station (DESC 6888) and DESC's Okatie substation are not published. OSM has no named Okatie substation. Unnamed 115 kV substations near Okatie are at 32.3287,-80.9436 (way/185390957, tagged substation=distribution) and 32.2700,-80.9354 (way/498967269); both were re-checked through the OSM API on 2026-09-26.

Hooks substation (DESC; Hooks – Thurmond tie 6810 A, Hooks – Modoc 6809 G) is not named in OSM. OSM has a 115 kV substation named 'GPC <-> SCG&E Compensator Station' (way/1074904615, 33.65682,-82.15948, substation=compensation). It is about 3.4 km east of the OSM Thurmond Substation, in McCormick County, SC per Nominatim reverse geocoding. The name is mapper-supplied and unverified, so it is not used as evidence.

DESC 6810 A (Hooks – Thurmond 115kV Tie rebuild, ISD 12/31/2024) appears only in the 2024-2028 list and has no project record in the sc-ga-desc cluster, so no relation was created for it. Its absence from later lists suggests completion, but no source states that.

GPC 20277 (McIntosh – Purrysburg reactors, need 06/01/2026) and GPC 20793/20794 (Evans Primary – Thurmond Dam rebuilds, need 2033) do not appear in the 2025 SERTP plan (no 'Purrysburg' or 'Thurmond' hits), although that plan covers 2026-2035. Their current status is unconfirmed.

SERTP 2025 vs GPC 2024 ten-year plan conflicts, kept side by side for the sc-ga-gpc cluster. Goshen (Sav) – McIntosh 115 kV rebuild (GPC 20065): GPC need 2027-06-01 with 100C 795 ACSR Drake, vs SERTP in-service 2028 with 200°C 1351 ACSS (p.111). Goshen – Kraft 115 kV rebuild (GPC 20785): GPC lists 9.3 mi, need 2027-06-01; SERTP splits it into 3.48 mi in 2027 (p.93) and 3.04 mi Goshen–Rice Hope in 2031 (p.157).

SERTP 2025 p.107 'MCINTOSH 230 KV, BREAKER CONTROL RELAY UPGRADES' (2028, for interconnection of a proposed generating facility) has no 'SAV:' prefix, and Alabama also has McIntosh/West McIntosh facilities. Georgia Power ownership and location are unconfirmed, so it is not modeled.

Effingham County 500 kV: substation site, line endpoints, line length and in-service date are not published, and there is no map. Callaway Road – Thomson has no in-service date. None of the five construction windows (two preconstruction, three general-construction) has a published end.
The DESC OASIS 'Message Board - Information Postings' PDF (updated 12/11/2025) could not be retrieved because of a TLS certificate-chain error. It was not bypassed, not cached and not cited.

Other Georgia Power project pages listed on the transmission-projects index (Hatch–Wadley 500 kV, Ashley Park, Tomochichi–Towaliga and others) were not modeled. Only Callaway–Thomson and Effingham are near the SC border.
The GPC ten-year plan names the terminal 'Thurmond Dam (USA)'. The '(USA)' suffix is not explained in the source, so the facility's owner (federal or Georgia Power) is not inferred.
issuesFixed: Re-ran find_excerpt.py on all 47 unique original excerpts (source, excerpt, page) and on the 11 added here, 58 in the final cluster. Every one was found on its cited page or section. Each claim was then checked against the surrounding text, and the unsupported ones listed below were fixed.

Preconstruction window ends for Effingham and Callaway–Thomson had been inferred as the start of construction; neither page publishes an end to land acquisition. Both are now open-ended sentinels (not published), and the Spring 2027 excerpt no longer serves as an end bound for Effingham.

Effingham caveat said 'Effingham' was not in the 2025 SERTP plan. It does appear there, on p.226, as a generating-plant name in the modeled-resources table, not as a transmission project. The caveat is corrected.

SC PSC briefing: the page only announces a rescheduled briefing, so 'held a March 2026 briefing' became 'scheduled a March 5, 2026 briefing'. Source publishedAt corrected from '2026-02' to '2026-02-17' (page date 'Tue, 02/17/2026'), and the requesters (ORS, DESC, Santee Cooper, Duke) were added as evidence.

Thurmond interconnection: 'Timing does not overlap' was inferred from DESC's in-service date alone. It is reworded: no construction window is published for 6810 A, and the plans as published do not suggest concurrent work. The J Strom Thurmond Dam OSM operator is now quoted as tagged ('U.S. Corps of Engineers').
Hooks note: the 'GPC <-> SCG&E Compensator Station' is about 3.4 km from the OSM Thurmond Substation, not 2.9 km (recomputed from OSM API coordinates).

Purrysburg note: 'Jasper Substation' is named in OSM, so it is no longer called unnamed. Nominatim returns several Purrysburg Road segments in Jasper County, not only Hardeeville. The claim that Purrysburg is a place in Jasper County, SC is replaced with what Nominatim actually returns.

McIntosh note: the OSM claim was verified by line geometry. Way/185380584 (115 kV) joins McIntosh Substation to a Jasper County, SC substation, and a 115 kV line tagged 'Dominion Energy' continues toward Okatie. These stay labeled mapper-supplied context, not evidence.

System-level interface: added the Table A6.2 column header, the 2027 row and the sign convention as verified excerpts, so the 0 MW DESC value is backed by text. Removed the generic SERTP p.10 'coordination and joint modeling' excerpt, which does not name DESC. Added the SERTP-SCRTP OATT process statement and the SCRTP SOCO-to-DESC economic transfer studies, both labeled study or process context.

Replaced generic date excerpts that match many pages ('Need Date 06/01/2026 Start Date 01/01/2024' on 8 pages) with Teams-number-anchored excerpts for 20277, 20793, 20794, 14222 and 17993. Added printed page labels (Page 240/241/250/255 of 304) and ID-anchored DESC title excerpts (6888, 6810 A).
